description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, return the inorder traversal of its nodes' values. Inorder traversal visits nodes in the order: Left, Root, Right.
description.hi: Ek binary tree ka root diya hai, uske nodes ki values ka inorder traversal return karo. Inorder traversal mein nodes is order mein visit hote hain: Left, Root, Right.

explanation.en: Inorder: left of 1 is null, visit 1, go right to 2, left of 2 is 3, visit 3, visit 2
explanation.hi: Inorder: 1 ka left null hai, 1 visit karo, right mein 2 pe jao, 2 ka left 3 hai, 3 visit karo, 2 visit karo
Khali tree se khali list milti hai

hints.en: Use recursion: go left, process root, go right
hints.hi: Recursion use karo: pehle left jao, root process karo, phir right jao

hints.en: Can also be done iteratively using a stack
hints.hi: Stack use karke iteratively bhi kar sakte ho

approach.en: Recursively traverse left subtree, visit root, then traverse right subtree.
approach.hi: Recursively left subtree traverse karo, root visit karo, phir right subtree traverse karo.

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, find its maximum height. The height of a binary tree is the number of edges on the longest path from the root to a leaf node.
description.hi: Ek binary tree ka root diya hai, uski maximum height nikalo. Binary tree ki height root se sabse door wale leaf node tak ke longest path mein edges ki sankhya hai.

explanation.hi: Longest path: 3 -> 20 -> 15 (ya 3 -> 20 -> 7), jisme 2 edges hain
Single node tree ki height 0 hoti hai

hints.en: Height = 1 + max(height of left subtree, height of right subtree)
hints.hi: Height = 1 + max(left subtree ki height, right subtree ki height)

hints.en: Base case: empty tree has height -1
hints.hi: Base case: empty tree ki height -1 hoti hai

approach.en: Recursively find height of left and right subtrees and return 1 + max of both.
approach.hi: Recursively left aur right subtrees ki height nikalo aur 1 + dono ka max return karo.

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, return the level order traversal of its nodes' values. (i.e., from left to right, level by level).
description.hi: Ek binary tree ka root diya hai, uske nodes ki values ka level order traversal return karo. (yaani left se right, level by level).

explanation.en: Only one level with one node
explanation.hi: Sirf ek level hai ek node ke saath

hints.en: Use a queue (BFS). Process all nodes at current level before moving to next
hints.hi: Queue (BFS) use karo. Current level ke saare nodes process karo, phir next level pe jao

hints.en: Track the number of nodes at each level using queue size
hints.hi: Har level pe nodes ki sankhya queue size se track karo

approach.en: Use BFS with a queue. For each level, process all nodes in the queue and add their children.
approach.hi: BFS use karo queue ke saath. Har level pe queue ke saare nodes process karo aur unke children add karo.

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.titleHi: Check Karo BST Hai Ya Nahi

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it is a valid Binary Search Tree (BST). A valid BST has the property that for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly less and all values in its right subtree are strictly greater.
description.hi: Ek binary tree ka root diya hai, check karo ki ye valid Binary Search Tree (BST) hai ya nahi. Valid BST mein har node ke liye, uske left subtree ki saari values strictly chhoti hoti hain aur right subtree ki saari values strictly badi hoti hain.

explanation.hi: 1 < 2 < 3, valid BST hai

explanation.en: Node 4 is in the right subtree of 5 but 4 < 5, so not a valid BST
explanation.hi: Node 4, 5 ke right subtree mein hai lekin 4 < 5, isliye valid BST nahi hai

hints.en: Just checking left child < root < right child is NOT enough. You need to check entire subtrees.
hints.hi: Sirf left child < root < right child check karna kaafi NAHI hai. Poore subtrees check karne padte hain.

hints.en: Pass min and max bounds while recursing
hints.hi: Recursion mein min aur max bounds pass karo

approach.en: Recursively validate each node with a valid range (min, max). Left child must be in (min, node.val) and right child in (node.val, max).
approach.hi: Recursively har node ko ek valid range (min, max) ke saath validate karo. Left child (min, node.val) mein hona chahiye aur right child (node.val, max) mein.

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of BST
problems.titleHi: BST mein Lowest Common Ancestor Dhundho

description.en: Given a Binary Search Tree and two nodes p and q, find the Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA). The LCA is the deepest node that is an ancestor of both p and q.
description.hi: Ek Binary Search Tree aur do nodes p aur q diye hain, unka Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) dhundho. LCA woh sabse deep node hai jo p aur q dono ka ancestor hai.

explanation.en: Node 6 is the LCA of nodes 2 and 8
explanation.hi: Node 6, nodes 2 aur 8 ka LCA hai

explanation.en: Node 2 is the LCA since 2 is an ancestor of 4 and also itself
explanation.hi: Node 2 LCA hai kyunki 2 khud 4 ka ancestor hai

constraints: p and q exist in the tree

hints.en: Use BST property: if both p and q are smaller than root, LCA is in left subtree
hints.hi: BST property use karo: agar p aur q dono root se chhote hain, to LCA left subtree mein hai

hints.en: If one is on each side, current node is the LCA
hints.hi: Agar ek left side pe hai aur ek right side pe, to current node hi LCA hai

approach.en: If both p and q are smaller, go left. If both are larger, go right. Otherwise current node is LCA.
approach.hi: Agar p aur q dono chhote hain to left jao. Dono bade hain to right jao. Warna current node LCA hai.

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, return the length of the diameter of the tree. The diameter is the length of the longest path between any two nodes. This path may or may not pass through the root.
description.hi: Ek binary tree ka root diya hai, tree ka diameter return karo. Diameter kisi bhi do nodes ke beech ke longest path ki length hai. Ye path root se hokar guzar bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi.

explanation.en: Longest path is 4 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3 or 5 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3, length = 3 edges
explanation.hi: Longest path hai 4 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3 ya 5 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3, length = 3 edges
Path hai 2 -> 1, length = 1

hints.en: Diameter at any node = height of left subtree + height of right subtree
hints.hi: Kisi bhi node pe diameter = left subtree ki height + right subtree ki height

hints.en: Track the maximum diameter seen so far while computing heights
hints.hi: Heights compute karte waqt ab tak ka maximum diameter track karo

approach.en: Compute height recursively, updating a global diameter variable at each node as left_height + right_height.
approach.hi: Recursively height compute karo, har node pe global diameter variable ko left_height + right_height se update karo.

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, return the zigzag level order traversal of its nodes' values. (i.e., from left to right, then right to left for the next level, and alternate between).
description.hi: Ek binary tree ka root diya hai, uske nodes ki values ka zigzag level order traversal return karo. (yaani pehle left se right, phir right se left, aur aise alternate karo).

explanation.hi: Ek node, sirf ek level

hints.en: Use BFS like normal level order, but reverse alternate levels
hints.hi: Normal level order jaisa BFS use karo, par alternate levels reverse karo

hints.en: Use a flag to track direction and toggle it after each level
hints.hi: Direction track karne ke liye flag use karo aur har level ke baad toggle karo

approach.en: Perform level order traversal using BFS. For odd levels, reverse the collected values before adding to result.
approach.hi: BFS use karke level order traversal karo. Odd levels ke liye, result mein add karne se pehle values reverse karo.

problems.title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
problems.titleHi: Binary Tree ko Serialize aur Deserialize Karo

description.en: Design an algorithm to serialize a binary tree to a string and deserialize that string back to the original tree structure. Serialization is converting the tree to a string, and deserialization is reconstructing the tree from the string.
description.hi: Ek algorithm design karo jo binary tree ko string mein serialize kare aur us string se wapas original tree structure ko deserialize kare. Serialization matlab tree ko string mein convert karna, aur deserialization matlab string se tree wapas banana.

explanation.en: Serialize tree to string, then deserialize back to same tree structure
explanation.hi: Tree ko string mein serialize karo, phir wapas same tree structure mein deserialize karo
Khali tree ka serialization bhi khali hoga

hints.en: Use preorder traversal with a special marker for null nodes
hints.hi: Null nodes ke liye special marker ke saath preorder traversal use karo

hints.en: For deserialization, use the same order and reconstruct recursively
hints.hi: Deserialization ke liye same order use karo aur recursively reconstruct karo

approach.en: Use preorder DFS. Serialize by appending node values with commas, using 'null' for empty nodes. Deserialize by splitting the string and recursively building the tree.
approach.hi: Preorder DFS use karo. Serialize karne ke liye node values commas ke saath append karo, empty nodes ke liye 'null' use karo. Deserialize karne ke liye string split karo aur recursively tree banao.

problems.title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
problems.titleHi: Binary Tree mein Maximum Path Sum Nikalo

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, return the maximum path sum of any non-empty path. A path is a sequence of nodes where each pair of adjacent nodes has an edge connecting them. A node can only appear in the path at most once. The path does not need to pass through the root.
description.hi: Ek binary tree ka root diya hai, kisi bhi non-empty path ka maximum path sum return karo. Path nodes ka ek sequence hai jisme har adjacent pair ke beech edge hoti hai. Ek node path mein zyada se zyada ek baar aa sakta hai. Path ko root se guzarna zaroori nahi hai.

hints.en: At each node, the max path sum through that node = node.val + max(0, left) + max(0, right)
hints.hi: Har node pe, us node se hokar max path sum = node.val + max(0, left) + max(0, right)

hints.en: But when returning to parent, you can only take one branch (left or right), not both
hints.hi: Par parent ko return karte waqt sirf ek branch (left ya right) le sakte ho, dono nahi

approach.en: At each node, calculate the max gain from left and right children (clamped to 0). Update global max with node.val + leftGain + rightGain. Return node.val + max(leftGain, rightGain) to parent.
approach.hi: Har node pe left aur right children se max gain calculate karo (0 se clamp karo). Global max ko node.val + leftGain + rightGain se update karo. Parent ko node.val + max(leftGain, rightGain) return karo.

problems.title: Balanced Binary Tree
problems.titleHi: Check Karo Binary Tree Balanced Hai Ya Nahi

description.en: Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it is height-balanced. A height-balanced binary tree is a tree in which the depth of the two subtrees of every node never differs by more than one.
description.hi: Ek binary tree ka root diya hai, check karo ki ye height-balanced hai ya nahi. Height-balanced binary tree woh hai jisme har node ke dono subtrees ki depth ka difference kabhi 1 se zyada nahi hota.

explanation.en: All nodes have subtree height difference <= 1
explanation.hi: Saare nodes ke subtree height difference <= 1 hai

explanation.en: Node 2 (left) has left subtree height 2 and right subtree height 0, difference = 2
explanation.hi: Node 2 (left) ka left subtree height 2 hai aur right subtree height 0 hai, difference = 2

hints.en: A tree is balanced if left and right subtrees are balanced AND their heights differ by at most 1
hints.hi: Tree balanced hai agar left aur right subtrees balanced hain AUR unki heights ka difference zyada se zyada 1 hai

hints.en: Optimize by returning -1 from height function if subtree is unbalanced
hints.hi: Optimize karo: agar subtree unbalanced hai to height function se -1 return karo

approach.en: Use a helper that returns -1 if unbalanced, otherwise returns height. Check if abs(leftHeight - rightHeight) <= 1 at every node.
approach.hi: Ek helper function use karo jo -1 return kare agar unbalanced hai, warna height return kare. Har node pe check karo abs(leftHeight - rightHeight) <= 1 hai ya nahi.
